completeness.description: Are all 9 required fields filled with substantive content? Are key_technical_features actually 5 distinct items? Are citations present for each field?

scoring.0: Multiple fields missing, empty, or placeholder values (e.g. N/A)
scoring.1: Most fields present but some are thin or generic
scoring.2: All fields filled with substantive, detailed content

specificity.description: Is technical_description concrete (mentions actual techniques, algorithms, architectures) or vague? Are inventor_keywords precise domain terms or generic words?

scoring.1: Some specific terms but mixed with generic language
scoring.2: Precise technical language, named algorithms/techniques, domain-specific terms

internal_consistency.description: Does solution_approach actually address the problem_statement? Do key_technical_features align with technical_description? Does statutory_category match what is described?

scoring.0: Contradictions or clear misalignment between fields
scoring.1: Generally consistent but some fields feel disconnected
scoring.2: All fields tell a coherent, aligned story

citation_quality.description: Are citation snippets actual quoted text (specific sentences with section references) or fabricated/paraphrased? Do they look like real paper excerpts?

scoring.0: Citations look fabricated, overly generic, or missing section references
scoring.1: Some citations look real but others are paraphrased or vague
scoring.2: Citations are clearly direct quotes with section IDs, read like real paper excerpts

patent_readiness.description: Is invention_name concise and descriptive? Is the description detailed enough that a patent searcher could find prior art from it?

scoring.0: Name is vague or too broad, description lacks searchable technical detail
scoring.1: Reasonable name, description has some searchable terms but could be sharper
scoring.2: Clear inventive name, description contains enough technical specifics for effective prior art search
